candidates.change_summary: NETM() now sets owner to msg.sender and also assigns the owner's balance to totalSupply instead of totalDistributed, changing balances[owner].
NETM() no longer assigns balances to owner (removed the assignment), leaving balances unchanged after the call.
NETM() sets balances[owner] to zero instead of totalDistributed, clearing the owner's balance when called.
onlyOwner modifier condition inverted to deny the real owner and allow others, changing which callers can invoke NETM and thus who can cause balances changes.
Remove decrement of allowed[_from][msg.sender] so allowance is not reduced after transferFrom.
Set allowance to zero after transferFrom, clearing allowed[_from][msg.sender] regardless of _amount.
Change assert to require so payload-size check reverts with a different error behaviour (still enforces size), which can alter whether allowed is observed after transferFrom in some call contexts.

Disable the payload-size check by replacing its body with a no-op, allowing transferFrom calls with short calldata that previously would have asserted and reverted, potentially changing observed allowed state.
